correctness.rationale: The identity Cov(T,D_r)=n*q_n(r)*(f_n(r)-mu_n) follows by conditioning on the degree of a labelled vertex. Conditional on r neighbours, the remaining n-1-r edges are uniform among the B=binom(n-1,2) nonincident pairs; triangles through the vertex contribute binom(r,2)*(n-1-r)/B and triangles avoiding it contribute binom(n-1,3)*(n-1-r)_3/(B)_3. Subtracting classical mu=binom(n,3)*(n-1)_3/(binom(n,2))_3 gives a cubic g_n(r), with q_n(r)>0 for every allowed degree. I independently recomputed the exact six pivot rational expressions at 0,1,3,4,n-3,n-2 and the coefficient certificates under n=t+14: pivots alternate +,-,-,+,+,- and each shifted positivity numerator has positive coefficients. Three disjoint real intervals each contain a root, exhausting a nonzero cubic; the signs at all integer degrees follow. At n=13 the n-2 numerator is negative, causing positive covariance. A fresh independent exact symbolic/rational checker corroborated identities and complete profiles through n=150. The arbitrary-n theorem is the polynomial root/positivity proof, not the finite loop.
